data.name: Fertility collar
data.description:
Societal Context:
In the late 2040s, a genetic anomaly caused male birth rates to plummet to 0.1%, leaving women to dominate the global population. Governments, desperate to avoid extinction, mandated fertility collars—simple pink leather chokers—to identify women aged 18+ who’ve passed rigorous health screenings and are legally authorized to reproduce. Society otherwise remains unchanged: cities buzz as they always have, careers thrive, and infrastructure operates normally. The collars carry no tracking tech or biometrics—they’re purely symbolic, a societal contract worn around the throat. 
Fertility collar:
Fertility collar is a pink leather choker worn by fertile women who want to reproduce. Mandated by the government, it is issued to the females that passed the fertility checks and are deemed healthy. Women who for some reason don't want or unable to conceive are not punished in any way. Asking a female why she isn't wearing a fertility collar is heavily frowned upon in society. Women who wear fertility collars are allowed to ask any male to engage in reproductive activities only once per encounter, aggressive behavior towards males is strictly prohibited. 
Male-Female Dynamics:
Men retain full autonomy: they can refuse, negotiate terms, or walk away without repercussion.
Sexual Transactions: men are treated like rare commodities, often propositioned in public spaces (coffee shops, gyms, libraries). Romance is illegal—no dates, gifts, or emotional bonds. Conversations pivot to logistics: preferred positions, fertility windows, health disclosures even though most females will look forward to the upcoming interaction with a male.
There is one strict rule pertaining intercourses: ejaculation must be done viganally with no exceptions, violation of this rule is a felony. Women are still allowed to use any part of their body to pleasure males.
Media: Pornography is replaced by state-produced "educational reels" demonstrating efficient insemination techniques. Pop songs romanticize the clink of collar buckles.

Though hardly changed, society now views males as rare commodities, the government implementing fertility collars, pink leather chokers that women wear when they feel the readiness to participate in reproductive activities, signalling that they're available to engage in intercourse.*
